overview: This community session addressed questions regarding the Medford High School science labs, specifically explaining why the recently renovated B-Building wing cannot be preserved as-is under current state regulations.

items.title: MHS Science Labs Preservation Challenges
items.summary: Jenny Graham and Matt Rice explained that the existing science labs cannot be kept as-is because they are smaller than the 1,440 square feet required by the MSBA and do not meet current structural codes for lateral wind design.

subject: High School Science Labs Preservation Challenges
